text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Guess I showed you an uncool side of me.
I really thought I had it in the bag... ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Well, I'm fine. I'll switch gears and do my best right away."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wanna win next time.
Yeah... I seriously wanna win.
choice_data_list: ...Are you sure there's no lie in those feelings?
...There's no lie in how you feel, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wanna win next time.
Yeah... I seriously wanna win.
choice_data_list: ...Are you sure there's no lie in those feelings?
...There's no lie in how you feel, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, how dependable!
I'm counting on you, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, a one-way street isn't great either.
Like, how should I put it... will you lean on me too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Like, 'This girl is 100% definitely gonna win the next race!
I believe in her!' ...you know?"
choice_data_list: Of course, I believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Sweet! Thanks!
Palmer-san, I'm starting to feel confident now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win for sure! Totally win!
Just watch me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Totes! Like, isn't that totally obvious?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've worked so hard up until now
because I want to win!
Ever since you chose me, always!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh?
Palmer-san, are you perking up...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Haah, so this is what they call giving a push, huh?
You're pretty sly yourself, you know~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thanks.
Alright, I'll definitely show you a win next time!
